description_en: Queries a list of workspaces by calling ListProducts
description_zh: 调用ListProducts查询工作空间列表
kebab_example: aliyun mhub list-products --offset 1 --size 20 --simple false --product-name '我的项目' --search-key-word example-string --page-num 1 --page-size 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListProducts

parameters.help_en:
The number of items to display per page.
Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh:
每页可显示的项目的个数。
取值范围为：1-100
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use simplified query mode.

true: Simplified query. The encodedIcon and Platforms fields are not returned.
false: Full query. All fields are returned
parameters.help_zh:
设置是否为简化查询。

true：简化查询。不返回encodedIcon和Platforms两个字段。
false：非简化查询。返回全部字段
parameters.name: simple

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to perform a fuzzy match by project name
parameters.help_zh: 输入关键字，按项目名称模糊查询
